from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DeferredTaxLiability(BaseModel):
    """A single deferred tax liabilities entry from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the report")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The deferred tax liabilities amount in yuan")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is ending or beginning balance, e.g. '期末' or '年初'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    deferred_tax_liabilities: list[DeferredTaxLiability]
